provenance.source: Llei 2/2023 de Catalunya, escala autonomica de l IRPF
provenance.notes: Nine-band scale in force since 2023, carried forward to 2026. NOT verified against the current regional text.

regionalDeductions.label: Deduccio per lloguer de l habitatge habitual
regionalDeductions.help: Restricted to specific circumstances (under 32, unemployed for 183 days or more, degree of disability of 65% or more, widowed and 65 or over) and to regional income limits. Tick eligibility only if you meet them.

inputSchema.label: I qualify for the Catalan rent deduction
inputSchema.help: Only for the restricted circumstances listed and within the regional income limits.

inputSchema.label: Rent paid during the year
inputSchema.help: The deduction is 10% of this, capped at 300 EUR.

omissions: Catalan birth, adoption, donation and mortgage-interest regional deductions are not modelled in v1.
